g.text: What to ask the device team for -- and what to stop asking for
Left: nothing else in the chain is uncertain enough to matter. Capacity is geometry, read BW is fabric-bound, write BW closed at 1.14% (Gate 5).
Give us E/bit and the stack cross-section and the paper has a point on it instead of a map.
